resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts places Rocky Top at 9S-11W-34 and has it in use in 1951 and 1952. The Osbornes list has a Rocky Top at 07 S. 09 W. 9, used 1920 to 1950. Nothing in the sources says whether these are one site; the sources are left unresolved here.

The register's Rocky Point cabin and the Osbornes Rocky Top share the 2,890 elevation and a 1920s start into the 1950s, so they may be one site. The Rocky Top record's firelookout link points to the Rocky Point page, not to a Rocky Top page.

notes_for_editor: Record point (44.7409, -124.0213, from west_us_lookouts) is about 32 km south-west of the Rocky Point register point (44.97467, -123.79177); the register point lies about 26 km north and 18 km east of it. Its firelookout link (rockypoint.html) is about the Rocky Point cabin, not this site. Do not use the Kemnow page rocky-top1.html for this record: it is a different Rocky Top (Willamette NF, Detroit district, Marion County, the us-or-rocky-top record). Its 1950 Statesman and 1935 Register-Guard items are not about Lincoln County. Consider whether this record should merge with the Rocky Point register site (FFLOS US 732) or stay separate. The FFLA county list has no Lincoln entry under the name Rocky Top. Status and access are unknown; no visit information found. The ORWW table gives no unit for elevation.
